name: Tool_Systems
description: Player tools for interacting with the environment: scanner, shovel, weapon, and construction tools.

questions.question: Do tools teach real science through their use?
questions.answer: Yes. The scanner teaches geology/meteorology/astronomy. Construction tools teach engineering.

questions.question: Does the scanner teach geology/meteorology/astronomy?
questions.answer: Yes. The scanner (Educational_Scanner feature) teaches real geology through terrain analysis.

questions.question: Do construction tools teach engineering principles?
questions.answer: Yes. Shovel/mining tool teaches soil stratigraphy. Welding tool teaches metallurgy.

questions.question: Can tools be combined in educational ways?
questions.answer: Yes. Scanner + construction tool = find resources + build shelter. Educational combo.

questions.question: Are tools visually satisfying to use?
questions.answer: Yes. A satisfying tool-use animation and effect is screenshot-worthy.

questions.question: Does the scanner generate press coverage?
questions.answer: Yes. A scanner that teaches real science is unique and press-worthy.

questions.question: Do tools differentiate us from other survival games?
questions.answer: Yes. Our tools teach real science. Competitors use fictional tool mechanics.

questions.question: Is tool use intuitive and satisfying?
questions.answer: Tool use must be immediately satisfying (visual feedback, sound, result).

questions.question: Do tools have realistic physics interactions?
questions.answer: Tools should have realistic physics interactions (mining speed depends on rock hardness).

questions.question: Do tools degrade or need maintenance?
questions.answer: Yes. Tools degrade with use and need maintenance/repair. Teaches material durability.

questions.question: Can tools be upgraded or enhanced?
questions.answer: Yes. Scanner upgrades reveal deeper data. Construction upgrades build stronger shelters.

questions.question: Do tools interact with the educational scanner system?
questions.answer: Yes. Scanner is the primary educational tool. Other tools support the educational loop.

questions.question: Can existing Tool_Scanner_Model be refined quickly?
questions.answer: Tool_Scanner_Model can be refined by fixing the generator (already identified).

questions.question: Can Tool_Scanner_Material be refined quickly?
questions.answer: Tool_Scanner_Material can be refined similarly — fix material references in generator.

questions.question: Do new tools need generator changes?
questions.answer: New tools beyond scanner/shovel/weapon need generator changes for new actor classes.

questions.question: Can tools be tested via sleepwalker?
questions.answer: Yes. Tool usage can be tested via sleepwalker beats (equip, use, observe result).

questions.question: Does the tool system already exist in the generator?
questions.answer: Partially. Tool classes exist in generated code. New tools need generator entries.

questions.question: Are tool behaviors data-driven?
questions.answer: Tool behaviors are partially data-driven (stats, damage, range). Core logic is C++.

questions.question: Can new tools be added without code changes?
questions.answer: New tools need generator entries + C++ behavior. Not purely data-driven.

questions.question: Does the MCP bridge support tool testing?
questions.answer: Yes. MCP bridge can spawn tool actors and verify their properties.

questions.question: Does this depend on the Educational_Scanner?
questions.answer: Partially. Scanner is independent. Construction tools depend on shelter system.

questions.question: Does this depend on the generator being fixed?
questions.answer: Partially. New tools need generator entries but existing tools work without fixes.

questions.question: Does this prove the core gameplay loop works?
questions.answer: Yes. Working tool system proves the core gameplay loop (scan, gather, build).

questions.question: Was this derived from Loop 4?
questions.answer: Derived from Loop 4 (Tools) definition.

questions.question: Do tools conflict with the educational demo focus?
questions.answer: Minor — tool development takes time from the environmental demo. Acceptable.

questions.question: What UE5 Blueprint tool knowledge is needed?
questions.answer: UE5 Blueprint tool creation knowledge. Understanding of the generator tool patterns.

questions.question: Do tools serve the most famous educational RPG goal?
questions.answer: Yes. Tools that teach real science directly serve the educational RPG goal.

questions.question: What is sacrificed by building tools now?
questions.answer: Refining existing tools (scanner model/material) costs little. New tools defer other features.

questions.question: What evidence shows tool systems drive engagement?
questions.answer: Satisfying tool systems drive player engagement. Minecraft proved this.

questions.question: Do tools chain reach a human learning real skills?
questions.answer: Yes. Player learns real material properties and tool physics through gameplay.

questions.question: Does this work in UE5.8 without hacks or workarounds?
questions.answer: Could zoom into: scanner tool, shovel tool, weapon tool, construction tool. Scanner is the priority.

questions.question: Does this run at 30+ fps on the target GPU (RTX 3060)?
questions.answer: Missing: tool durability system, tool upgrade system, tool crafting.

questions.question: Can a colorblind or hearing-impaired player fully experience this?
questions.answer: Parent (game systems) is designed. No blocker.

questions.question: Does this have sound design that matches the visual quality?
questions.answer: Scanner tool is high priority (build with demo). Other tools defer.

questions.question: Can the community extend or modify this?
questions.answer: Partially blocked by: generator needs fixes for new tool entries.

questions.question: Can this be translated without breaking?
questions.answer: Tool stats, models, and materials can be exposed as moddable data tables.

questions.question: Does this feature need sub-features, or is it detailed enough at this level?
questions.answer: Needs sub-features at deeper zoom level. Defer until v2 scope.

questions.question: Are there sibling features missing at this level of the tree?
questions.answer: Sub-features exist in the loop board. Create when scoped.

questions.question: Is the parent feature complete enough to support this?
questions.answer: Parent systems are designed at high level. No blocker.

questions.question: Should this be built before or after its siblings?
questions.answer: Build after Environmental_Demo and Educational_Scanner. These are depth features.

questions.question: Does this block other features, or do others block this?
questions.answer: Blocked by animation system (NPC), weather system (Shelter), celestial data (Travel), generator fixes (Tools).

questions.question: Can this feature be verified by sleepwalker beat tests?
questions.answer: Yes. Sleepwalker can walk through this feature and verify state changes.

questions.question: Does this feature have automated regression tests?
questions.answer: Not yet. Needs MCP screenshot baseline + SSIM comparison for visual regression.

questions.question: What are the edge cases and failure modes?
questions.answer: Edge cases include: network interruption, empty state, concurrent access, corrupted data. Documented in threat model.

questions.question: Can this feature be tested in isolation (unit test)?
questions.answer: Partially. Python modules have unit tests. UE5 Blueprint/C++ needs automated test framework.

questions.question: Is there a visual/performance baseline for regression detection?
questions.answer: Not yet. Needs MCP screenshot baseline + SSIM comparison for visual regression.
